model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the annual land area harvested for various crops over a period of years. The horizontal axis represents the years from 2013 to 2022, with each year equally spaced and labeled in Cyrillic script. The vertical axis is labeled "Хиляди хектари" (Thousands of Hectares) and displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1200, with tick labels at intervals of 200. The chart presents grouped bars, with each year showing a set of bars representing different countries: Argentina (black), United States (gray), Turkey (teal), Italy (yellow), France (red), China/Continental (light gray), and Spain (blue). The bars for each country are consistently colored across all years. The shortest bars, representing China/Continental, generally have values around 200-300, while the tallest bars, representing Spain, reach approximately 1100. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
